name: hud_ui_text_label_hit_test
description: HudUiTextLabel::HitTest accepts points inside visible measured text bounds and rejects hidden, left/above-origin, and beyond-width/height points.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bcea0 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiTextLabel class/table pass.
Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4bcea0 remains limited because the reused px/py stack argument slots are also MeasureString output locals.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bcea0 validates hidden flag 0x10 rejection, left/above-origin rejection, zImage_Font::MeasureString(textBuffer, fontHandle, outWidth, outLineAdvance), and inclusive right/bottom measured bounds checks.

The native HUD smoke verifies the text-label function table maps slot 0x5c / 4 to HitTest, accepts origin and inclusive measured right/bottom edges, rejects left/above/outside points, rejects flag 0x10, and checks multiline MeasureString line advance bounds.
